description: A shell script for downloading and installing Kubernetes client and server binaries, including options for different architectures, OS, and testing binaries. It detects environment details, downloads necessary tarballs, and extracts them into specified directories.

methods.name: detect_kube_release
methods.description: Detects the Kubernetes release version from a file or environment variable.

methods.name: detect_client_info
methods.description: Detects the client's OS and architecture for downloading appropriate binaries.

methods.name: md5sum_file
methods.description: Calculates the MD5 checksum of a file.

methods.name: sha512sum_file
methods.description: Calculates the SHA512 checksum of a file.

methods.name: download_tarball
methods.description: Downloads a tarball from a URL, verifies checksums, and saves it locally.

methods.name: extract_arch_tarball
methods.description: Extracts a tarball into a platform-specific directory.
